roleDraft.intent: Compare this role with Steve's supported experience.

messages.text: We want an AI agent on our docs site. Should we start with retrieval or with tools?

proposal.recommendation: Start with retrieval over the pages you already publish, and add one read-only tool once answers are cited and reviewed.
assumptions: Your docs are public and change weekly.
tradeoffs: Retrieval first is cheaper to evaluate, but it cannot take actions.
Tools first shows more capability, but every tool needs its own guardrails.
proposal.nextStep: List the twenty questions visitors ask most and check which pages answer them.

answer.uncertainty: This is general guidance from public work, not a review of your system.
